pois.name: قلعة عراد
pois.intro: Arad Fort is a 15th-century fort in Arad, Bahrain. Formerly guarding a separate island of its own, the fort and its surroundings have since been joined to Muharraq Island through land reclamation.

pois.name: Ahmed Abdul Rahim Traditional Caffee Shop
pois.nameEnglish: Ahmed Abdul Rahim Traditional Caffee Shop

pois.name: قلعة البحرين
pois.intro: The Qal'at al-Bahrain, also known as the Bahrain Fort or Portuguese Fort, is an archaeological site located in Bahrain.

pois.name: مسجد أحمد الفاتح
pois.intro: The Al-Fateh Mosque, also known as the Al-Fateh Islamic Center and as the Al Fateh Grand Mosque, is a large mosque, located in Manama, Bahrain. Encompassing 6,500 square metres, with the capacity to accommodate over 7,000 worshippers at a time, it was one of the largest mosques in the world.

pois.name: بيت القرآن
pois.intro: The Beit Al Qur'an is a multi-purpose complex dedicated to the Islamic arts and is located in Hoora, Bahrain. Established in 1990, the complex is most famous for its Islamic museum, which has been acknowledged as being one of the most renowned Islamic museums in the world.

pois.name: متحف البحرين الوطني
pois.intro: The Bahrain National Museum is the largest public museum in Bahrain and is the oldest national museum in the Persian Gulf. It is situated in Manama, adjacent to the National Theatre of Bahrain.

pois.name: Barbar Temple
pois.intro: The Barbar Temple is an archaeological site located in the village of Barbar, Bahrain, considered to be part of the Dilmun culture. The most recent of the three Barbar temples was rediscovered by a Danish archaeological team in 1954.

pois.name: Bahrain Mall
pois.intro: The Bahrain Mall is a multistorey shopping mall situated in Sanabis, Manama city of the Kingdom of Bahrain. The mall features 1,600 parking spaces.

pois.name: Adhari Park
pois.intro: Adhari Park is an amusement park located in the Kingdom of Bahrain. It is named after the nearby historic freshwater spring known locally as Ain Adhari.

pois.name: Gulf Speed One Gokarting @ Najma Sports Club
pois.nameEnglish: Gulf Speed One Gokarting @ Najma Sports Club

pois.name: الأفنيوز
pois.intro: The Avenues is a waterfront shopping center situated along Bahrain Bay, in Manama, Bahrain. Developed by the King Faisal Corniche Development Company, the $186 million development spans a total area of 273,000 m2 along a 1.5 km seafront corniche.

pois.name: مجمع السيف
pois.intro: Seef Mall is the second largest mall in the Kingdom of Bahrain. Managed by Seef Properties, the mall is located in the Seef district of the capital city, Manama.

pois.name: Al Aali Complex
pois.intro: El Centro Comercial Al Aali​ es uno de los mayores centros comerciales de Baréin, que cubre un espacio de 52.000 metros cuadrados. El centro comercial está situado en el distrito de Seef de la capital Manama, cerca del centro comercial Seef.

pois.name: مجمع الدانة
pois.intro: Dana Mall is an early shopping mall in the Seef District of Manama, the capital city of Bahrain. The exterior of the mall is in Jordanian stone and the interior includes domes and stained glass ceilings.

pois.nameEnglish: Al Bahair Mini Canyon and Reserve
